notes: Source disagreement: OpenAPI defaults the account-events limit to 50 and defines criteria as an array, while the rendered page says default 20 and shows criteria as an object (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/concepts/civilisations/index.md:47); the client forwards optional filters and accepts both criteria forms.
EventsClient::list sends every documented cursor, pagination, mute, device, name, category, and time filter and decodes EventLogResponse.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI has no 2xx or text/event-stream response, while the rendered page defines a persistent SSE response (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/events/stream/index.md:25); EventsClient implements the documented cursor and SSE framing.
OpenAPI provides no 2xx response schema and no rendered page documents this route's success body; the client assumes the account-event LocationEventListResponse.
MessagesClient::list sends cursor, limit, latest, and unread_only and decodes the complete MessageListResponse.
The per-replicant event log is explicitly deprecated and excluded from the public client in favor of the unified account event stream.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI declares no success response, while the rendered page documents HTTP 200 with a resolved-event object (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/concepts/civilisations/index.md:95); the client sends the empty-body mutation but exposes that response only as serde_json::Value.
MessagesClient::mark_read serializes ids or mark_all to the mutating route and decodes MessagesReadResponse.
DeviceLogsResponse provides the EventListResponse events array of DeviceLogEvent values and nullable integer next_cursor.
DeviceLogEvent represents created_at, device_code, device_type, event_type, id, nullable message, and open payload.
GameEvent models the complete account-event envelope, nullable associations, string cursor id, and open event payload.
EventLogResponse contains GameEvent entries and the nullable string next_cursor required by the account event log.
LocationEventListResponse models the location-event array and nullable integer cursor used by the account event response.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI defines nullable criteria as an array, while the rendered account-event example uses a single object (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/concepts/civilisations/index.md:69); the client accepts both but normalizes them to Vec<JsonObject>. The DTO has no named category field, leaving that OpenAPI property only in flattened extra.
MessageListResponse models messages, nullable integer next_cursor, and unread_message_count with the OpenAPI wire names.
Message models all eight documented inbox fields with matching wire names and scalar types.
MessagesReadRequest serializes the nullable id list and optional mark_all boolean used by the read mutation.
MessagesReadResponse exposes the documented status string.
